pages.ja:
主演は立ち去った。
舞台に残されたものは物言わぬ屍のみ。
それを、
何かが、呑み込んでいた。
死体は残らない。
板張りの床は底なしの沼となって、ずぶずぶと、男の動かぬ身体と粘つく紅い染みを平らげていく。

pages.en:
The players have left.

Nothing remains upon the stage but a silent corpse.

And something

is swallowing it.

No body will remain.

The wooden floor has become a bottomless mire. Slowly, hungrily, it devours the man’s motionless body and the sticky crimson stain beneath him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The lead actor has left.
The only ones remaining on the stage are silent corpses.
And…
…Something is devouring the corpses.
No bodies remain.
The wooden floor turns into a bottomless swamp, swallowing up the man’s flesh and spilled blood.

pages.ja:
それは男だけでなく、男に従ったモノさえ呑み込んだ。
サーヴァント
キャスターを象っていた魂とも言えるものが、黒い影に落下していく。
それは正当な流れではない。
敗北し、消滅したサーヴァントの行き着く先は聖杯のみ。
その法則を妨げるというのなら、いかなモノと言えど自滅自虐は避けられまい。

pages.en:
It swallows not only the man, but even the thing that served him.

What might be called the soul that had taken the form of the Servant Caster sinks into the black shadow.

This is not the proper course.

The Holy Grail is the sole destination of a Servant defeated and extinguished.

Anything that obstructs that law, whatever it may be, cannot escape the ruin and torment of its own being.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It consumes not only the man, but the one who obeyed him.
The soul that was Servant Caster is swallowed into the darkness.
It is not a legitimate flow.
The defeated Servants are to be consumed by the Holy Grail.
If anyone interferes with this balance, it will only bring his own death and destruction.

pages.en:
“————”

It weeps without sound.

Writhing in agony, choking, its innermost self laid bare, It finally swallows the first.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
It cries silently.
It writhes in pain, sobs, exposes itself, and finally consumes the first one.

pages.ja:
ヒタヒタと歩く。
声をあげる事もできないソレは、全身でそのイタミを表現する。
pages.jaRuby:
ヒタヒタと歩く。
声をあげる事もできないソレは、全身でそのイタミを表現する。
pages.en:
It walks with soft, wet footsteps.

Unable even to raise a voice, It expresses that PAIN with its entire body.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It walks on.
Lacking a voice, it expresses its pain with the whole of its body.

pages.ja:
それは言葉でもなければ感情でもない。
もとよりそんな機能は付属していない。
pages.jaRuby:
それは言葉でもなければ感情でもない。
もとよりそんな機能は付属していない。
pages.en:
It is neither speech nor emotion.

No such function belonged to It in the first place.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There are no words, nor emotion.
It never had those functions in the first place.

pages.ja:
だというのにソレは嘆いた。
自らの存在。
自らが存在するという事に、いま、初めて気がついた“何か”のように。
pages.jaRuby:
だというのにソレは[ruby text=な]嘆いた。
自らの存在。
自らが存在するという事に、いま、初めて気がついた“何か”のように。
pages.en:
And yet, It lamented.

Its own existence.

Like something that has only now, for the first time, become aware that it exists.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But it still grieves.
As if…
…It has become aware of its existence for the first time.
